All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Anchors
The anchors of a page: the addresses inside it, and whether any two things answer to the same one.
Breadcrumbs
The trail of a page: where it sits in the site, said twice — once for a person and once for a crawler — out of one list of steps.
Breadcrumbs.Builder
Steps in the order they are walked, from the top of the site towards this page.
Caption
Owner of the caption concept: short text attached to something.
Caption.Builder
 
Composable<K>
Something that becomes an element.
ContractBrokenException
The walk over a triple did not agree: an address resolving to nothing, a key declared and never filled, a template that cannot be read.
Demo
The kit's showcase, shipped with the library.
Element<K>
The single currency of composition: every element's build() returns one.
Element.Descriptor<K>
Builds a descriptor: adapter address plus data, terminal Element.Descriptor.build().
Element.Raw
Marker for a consumer fragment used as an element without a Java factory.
Element.Script
Marker for a behaviour script carried as an element.
ElementContract
The walk over a triple, handed to whoever writes an element.
Heading
Owner of the heading concept: anything with a heading composes this element instead of writing its own <h*>.
Heading.Builder
 
Hero
The page hero: a heading group (<hgroup> with eyebrow, H1, subtitle and meta lines), then a divider, an optional status badge and an optional action row.
Hero.Builder
 
MarkdownDialect
What puts #md into your templates: <div th:utext="${#md.toHtmlSafe(text)}">.
MarkdownExpressionObject
The object behind #md in templates: <div th:utext="${#md.toHtmlSafe(text)}">.
MarkdownExpressionObjectFactory
The registry entry behind #md: one name, and one object to hand out under it.
MarkdownRenderer
Markdown to safe HTML, rendered into templates through th:utext.
Md
The text of a page: markdown rendered by the #md dialect and sanitised on the way out, or an empty state when nothing has been written yet.
Md.Builder
 
MisuseException
The call was written wrong: a value the kit will not take, an argument that was not there, a state it will not go into.
Outline
The outline of a page: the headings on it, and whether they add up to something a reader can walk.
PageModel
The canvas of an arbitrary page: document properties (a title, what search engines and messengers are told about the page, and classes of your own if your theme needs them) plus an ordered collection of elements — the order of add is the order of rendering.
PageModel.Canvas
What a page is told about itself, and what goes on it.
PageModel.Robots
What a crawler may do with a page.
Rel
What a link says about itself, and what every element that links does with it.
Section
Owner of the section concept: a part of a page with a heading and whatever belongs under it.
Section.Builder
 
ThymekitAutoConfiguration
Makes the kit work as promised right after the dependency is added, with no configuration on the consumer's side: the markdown renderer, the dialect that puts #md into templates and the tidy-render dialect are registered here, and Spring Boot feeds dialect beans into its template engine by itself.
ThymekitException
What the kit refuses, in a shape somebody else's error handler can route.
TidyDialect
Tidy rendering: the HTML of a page should carry no trace of how the templates were formatted.
Topbar
The bar above a page: a way back, and where you are.
Topbar.Builder
The trail, and optionally the way back.
Tree
A page is a tree of elements, and this is what can be learned by walking it.
UnsoundPageException
The page does not add up: more than one title, a gap in the heading levels, two things answering to one name.
WhitespaceHandler
The stream handler behind TidyDialect: a whitespace node (or a run of them) becomes one newline indented by the current nesting depth.
